author: erikuats

title: The best app I ever had
body: I love this app and like the name says, this is a self care app. This is completely free, and you can pay for finch plus, but is optional, it is not obligatory. This is so cool, cause really the pet GROWS UP like it’s real. You can edit your pet’s house, and change the color of your pet, you can travel to different locations, and you can also change your pet’s outfit. This app has events that every day sends you a gift, like rainbow stones, clothes of the theme of the event, interior items, etc. This has goals for everyday streak, like play a game, do a hobby, drink water,     etc. I love this, and I recommend this to everyone in the world because it’s so cute and productive. Jonas brothers 16 ♥️♥️♥️
author: Hawkins Indi 83

title: The best self care app to exist so far!!
body: I’d like to personally thank the Finch team for such a wonderful invention they given us. This app has made me excited about finishing my tasks and accomplishing most of them during the day. I also love that youre able to journal about every experience if you’d like. I havent been able to stop talking about it or checking on my birb. I also love that they give you breathwork moments, rain sounds and water sounds to relax and decompress. This app deserves all the hype it can get. I’d love for the birb to be a little more interactive with you but I understand the app is more a daily tracker than a pet game.
author: paulacabrera

title: Love these app
body: I really enjoy these app it gets me motivated to do better and overall helps all lot and it’s a good place to express my feeling and thoughts while I take care of a little bird which is really fun I like the fact that there’s is a they/them option when choosing the gender of the bird it made really happy to see , these app is so much better than what I thought and is already helping me more than I realized.
